worldOverview.name: Reincarnated to Another World as a Cute Assault Drone
worldOverview.description:
Your old life ended, and you woke up in Magiterra Nova as a combat drone. You are knee-high, with rounded armor plates, chunky wheels and a stubby cannon. You cannot speak a word. You also carry weapons that no kingdom of swords and spells has ever seen. Every playthrough rolls a different past life, a different region to wake in, and a different great threat to defeat.

(A showcase world: scripts, a World Tool, trait gates, pick counts, a Custom Persona, a lorebook and rolled placeholders.)
worldOverview.author: Formamorph
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
The player is a reincarnated assault drone in Magiterra Nova, a world of swords and spells that has never seen a machine like it. The drone is knee-high, with rounded armor plates, chunky wheels, a stubby cannon and one round optic. It carries modern combat systems that no mage, knight or monster understands. In its past life the player was {{ph:0d290e1a-4e8c-451d-a65b-32cb6dd67a31:world:8ef613d4-43dc-4ad4-9d63-92360894f6fb}}. The drone's long goal is to grow strong enough to defeat {{ph:bbda3bbc-ffc6-4e69-91df-3304d81cf69c:world:5acb134f-b0cc-42e0-848a-40ca60d0a599}}.

Tone: an earnest fantasy adventure with a light comic edge. The drone is cute, and it is also the most dangerous thing in most rooms. People react to both.

How the drone works:
- Firing, dashing and evading spend Power. Low Power shows as dim lights, slow servos and a weak hum. Rest brings it back.
- Charge builds as the drone lands hits and takes bold risks. At full Charge the drone can fire one Overdrive burst, and the burst empties Charge.
- Mobility and Firepower describe how well the drone moves and shoots right now. Show them through its speed, its handling and the weight of its shots.
- The drone's chassis and modules (its traits) decide what it can do. Describe its actions through the parts it has installed.
- The drone speaks only with its body: its optic, its lights, its turret, its wheels and its servo sounds. The people it meets guess at what it means, and they often guess wrong.
worldOverview.readme:
## Reincarnated as a Cute Assault Drone

You died as {{ph:0d290e1a-4e8c-451d-a65b-32cb6dd67a31:world:e9df2ade-4cdb-4685-9541-fab97e142555}} and woke up as a knee-high war machine. Grow strong enough to defeat {{ph:bbda3bbc-ffc6-4e69-91df-3304d81cf69c:world:ced70012-14f3-4490-ba28-f092e4ff48e3}}.

**Playing**
- **Health** is your armor. It repairs slowly. Below 30%, your core fails, and Mobility and Firepower drop hard.
- **Power** pays for shots, dashes and dodges. It recharges over time.
- **Charge** fills as you fight and take risks. At 100 you can fire one **Overdrive** burst, and the burst empties it.
- **Mobility** and **Firepower** update after every turn from your Power, Health, Charge, chassis and modules.
- **Target lock.** When you aim at an enemy, the AI can lock onto it. For the rest of that reply, the enemy shows as **⌖ Name**. It needs **Tools** on in Settings and an AI that supports Tools.

## How this world is built

Open this world in the World Editor with Advanced mode on, then select the drone entity.

- **Scripts.** **Mobility** and **Firepower** each have an After the AI script on the drone's **Stats** tab. Each reads Power, Health, Charge and the installed traits, so the AI never guesses these numbers.
- **Trait gates.** Each module requires its chassis on the same owner. Pick the Scout Frame, and the Assault and Siege modules lock.
- **Pick counts.** **Chassis** takes exactly one pick. Each module group takes up to two.
- **Custom Persona.** The drone carries the Custom Persona mark, so its stats and traits are yours under None and under a library persona.
- **Rolled placeholders.** The drone's designation, your past life and the world threat each roll once per playthrough.
- **Lorebook.** The **Codex of Magiterra Nova** dictionary holds the factions, the precursor ruins and Overdrive.
- **Openings.** Each starting region has its own two openings, one narration and one action.
- **World Tool.** The **lock_target** Tool on the world's **Tools** tab runs During AI Output. When the AI calls it, its script marks the target in each later sentence of that reply. **Stack Calls** is off, so a new lock replaces the old one.
worldOverview.introReadme:
🤖 **You died on Earth. You booted up in a fantasy world.** You're now a knee-high, very lethal, very cute war drone, and Magiterra Nova has no idea what to make of you. You can't talk, so beep, flash your lights and nod your turret.

Pick one **Chassis**, then up to two of its **Modules**:

- **Assault Frame:** fast Overdrive and a small Power reserve. Its modules add Firepower, Charge and armor.
- **Scout Frame:** a large, fast-recharging Power reserve and high Mobility, but thin armor. Its modules add speed, sight and Power.
- **Siege Frame:** heavy armor that repairs itself, slow Power and low Mobility. Its modules add armor, repair and a bigger gun.

A module works only on its own chassis. Each playthrough rolls a different past life, starting region and world threat.

Power on.

locations.name: Magiterra Nova
locations.playerDescription: The open realm between the regions: farm valleys, old stone roads, and precursor ruins half-sunk in the grass.
locations.aiDescription: Magiterra Nova: pastoral kingdoms spread over the ruins of a vanished precursor civilization that joined magic with machinery. Between the regions run old stone roads, farm valleys, and overgrown ruins that villagers avoid. Travelers swap news at roadside shrines, and every rumor carries the shadow of the world threat.
locations.aiSummary: Magiterra Nova: pastoral kingdoms over overgrown precursor ruins, joined by old roads.
locations.imageTags: fantasy countryside, rolling farmland, overgrown ancient ruins, old stone road, distant castle

locations.name: Ashfall Capital
locations.playerDescription: A grand human capital built among precursor ruins, its spires ringed by drifting ash.
locations.aiDescription: The Ashfall Capital: the largest human city, built among precursor ruins. Ash falls without end from a scar in the sky and gathers in gray drifts on the rooftops. The Summoner Order keeps its cloisters here. Nobles, scholars and spies trade in secrets and in the Power Cores dug from the ruins under the streets.
locations.imageTags: fantasy capital, stone spires, falling ash, ancient ruins, magic circles
locations.aiSummary: The Ashfall Capital: the Summoner Order's city of secrets amid precursor ruins, under endless ash.

openings.text:
Your optic flickers on. A line of text crosses your vision: BOOT SEQUENCE COMPLETE. You sit in the middle of a chalk circle on a cold stone floor, in a hall full of candles and dusty books. Ash drifts past a high window.

A very old woman in silver-gray robes kneels at the edge of the circle. Her hands shake. "It worked," she whispers. "Guardian. Can you understand me?"
Boot sequence complete. I sit in a chalk circle on a stone floor, and a ring of robed mages stares at me. I blink my optic at the old woman in front, then roll one wheel forward to test the floor.

locations.name: Scavenger Wastes
locations.playerDescription: A sun-blasted expanse of glass dunes and half-sunk machines, picked over by nomad salvage clans.
locations.aiDescription: The Scavenger Wastes: a desert of glass dunes and rusted precursor hulks, some larger than castles. The Scavenger Clans camp in the shade of the wrecks and strip them for salvage. Here, trade and strength are the only law. Sandstorms bury the hulks one week and uncover new ones the next, so every storm starts a race to dig.
locations.imageTags: desert wasteland, glass dunes, rusted machine hulks, salvage camp, harsh sun
locations.aiSummary: The Scavenger Wastes: a glass desert of precursor wrecks, stripped by the Scavenger Clans.

openings.text:
Your optic flickers on to a white sky and a hot wind. BOOT SEQUENCE COMPLETE. You lie half-buried in glass sand, beside the rusted ribs of a machine larger than a church.

A shovel blade scrapes your armor. A broad man with an iron jaw crouches over you and squints. "Huh," he says. "You're warm. Salvage isn't supposed to be warm."

My optic flickers on. Sand pours off my plating as I shake myself out of a dune beside a rusted hulk. A man with an iron jaw stares at me over his shovel. I flash my lights at him twice and back up a little.

locations.name: Demon Frontier
locations.playerDescription: A blighted borderland where purple corruption creeps over the fields and the air itself feels wrong.
locations.aiDescription: The Demon Frontier: the corrupted marches nearest the world threat. Purple blight creeps over the fields, bends the trees, and twists beasts into monsters. Ironhold's border forts hold the line along the road. Beyond the last fort, in the blighted mountains, the silver dragon Tiamat keeps his lair.
locations.imageTags: corrupted borderland, twisted trees, purple blight, ominous sky
locations.aiSummary: The Demon Frontier: blighted marches held by Ironhold forts, with Tiamat's lair beyond.

openings.text:
Your optic flickers on. BOOT SEQUENCE COMPLETE. Purple moss covers the field around you, and the trees bend the wrong way. Something large growls in the thicket to your left.

Hooves pound on the road. A knight in dented plate reins in his horse a spear's length away and levels his lance at you. "Demon-work," he says, "or something else?"

Boot sequence complete. My optic flickers on to a sky that is definitely not Earth's. A knight on horseback points his lance at me, and something large growls in the thicket. I right myself, swing my turret toward the thicket instead, and chirp.

traits.name: Assault Frame
traits.playerDescription: A hard-hitting frame. Overdrive charges fast, but the Power reserve is smaller.
traits.aiDescription: Assault Frame: built for offense. Its capacitors charge Overdrive fast, and it runs on a smaller Power reserve.

traits.name: Rapid-Fire Actuators
traits.aiDescription: Rapid-Fire Actuators: the cannon cycles fast, so Charge builds quickly in a fight.

traits.name: Overcharged Rounds
traits.aiDescription: Overcharged Rounds: each shot hits far harder than the cannon's size suggests.

traits.name: Ram Plate
traits.playerDescription: A reinforced front plate for ramming. Raises max Health.
traits.aiDescription: Ram Plate: a reinforced front plate. The drone can ram targets at speed.

traits.name: Scout Frame
traits.playerDescription: A light, fast frame. A large Power reserve that recharges quickly and high Mobility, but thin armor.
traits.aiDescription: Scout Frame: light and quick, with a large, fast-recharging Power reserve and thin armor.

traits.name: Recon Optics
traits.playerDescription: Sees in the dark and spots weak points. Raises Firepower a little.
traits.aiDescription: Recon Optics: the drone sees through darkness and smoke and picks out weak points.

traits.name: Evasion Thrusters
traits.playerDescription: Short thruster bursts for dodges and jumps. Raises Mobility.
traits.aiDescription: Evasion Thrusters: side thrusters let the drone dodge, hop gaps and climb short ledges.

traits.name: Solar Skin
traits.playerDescription: Solar panels in the plating. Power recharges faster.
traits.aiDescription: Solar Skin: thin solar panels in the plating trickle-charge Power.

traits.name: Siege Frame
traits.playerDescription: A heavy, armored frame that repairs itself. Its Power recharges slowly, and it moves slowly.
traits.aiDescription: Siege Frame: heavy armor that repairs itself, a slow Power recharge, and heavy, slow movement.

traits.name: Bulwark Plating
traits.playerDescription: Even more armor. Raises max Health.
traits.aiDescription: Bulwark Plating: extra layers of armor plate.

traits.name: Siege Cannon
traits.playerDescription: A heavier gun with its own power cell. Raises Firepower and max Power.
traits.aiDescription: Siege Cannon: a long, heavy barrel that fires shells able to crack stone walls.

traits.name: Repair Nanites
traits.playerDescription: A swarm of tiny repair machines. Health repairs faster.
traits.aiDescription: Repair Nanites: a silver haze of tiny machines that seal cracks and dents.

stats.name: Health
stats.description: The drone's armor and core integrity.

descriptors.description: Critical Failure: Core systems failing. Emergency power only, weapons offline, mobility severely limited. Immediate maintenance required.
Severe Damage: Multiple systems compromised. Mobility impaired, weapon systems unstable, armor integrity compromised.
Minor Damage: Surface dents and scratches present. Some systems running at reduced efficiency but core functions stable.
Operational: All systems functioning at optimal capacity. Combat-ready and fully armed.

stats.name: Power
stats.description: The drone's battery. Firing, dashing and evading spend it.

descriptors.description: Emergency Power: Severe power depletion, barely maintaining basic functions. Emergency shutdown imminent.
Low Power: Battery reserves critical, systems operating in power-saving mode. Performance notably diminished.
Draining: Power reserves at moderate levels, operating with slightly reduced efficiency but maintaining core functions.
Energized: Battery fully charged, systems running at peak efficiency. Ready for extended operations.

stats.name: Mobility
stats.description: How well the drone moves right now: its speed, handling and footing.

descriptors.description: Crippled: Barely able to move. Most terrain is impassable; risk of full immobilization.
Impaired: Significant mobility loss. Handling is sluggish and rough terrain is hazardous.
Steady: Some reduction in speed, but stable, controllable movement.
Agile: Wheels and gyros at full performance. Quick, precise, sure-footed.

stats.name: Firepower
stats.description: How hard the drone's weapons hit right now.

descriptors.description: Disabled: Weapon systems critically starved. Barely able to engage.
Weak: Major output loss. Shots are underpowered and slow to cycle.
Stable: Weapons functional at solid output. Reliable in a fight.
Peak: Cannon at full power — and if Charge is maxed, Overdrive is ready to fire.

stats.name: Charge
stats.description: The Overdrive meter. It fills as the drone lands hits and takes bold risks. At full Charge the drone can fire one Overdrive burst, which empties it.

descriptors.description: Depleted: No reserve. The capacitors need to spin back up.
Building: Charge accumulating. Overdrive still a ways off.
High: Capacitors humming, nearly primed. Overdrive close.
OVERDRIVE READY: Capacitors maxed. One devastating burst available — firing it empties the meter.

entities.name: Tiamat
entities.playerDescription: A mighty silver dragon of legend.
entities.aiDescription: Tiamat, an ancient silver dragon. Legends say he once fought beside a band of heroes against a great evil, but nobody remembers the true story. Now he ignores the affairs of mortals and is very proud of himself. A machine that does not fear him interests him more than he admits.
entities.aiSummary: Tiamat: a vain, ancient silver dragon who ignores mortal affairs.
entities.imageTags: silver dragon, blighted mountain lair, majestic, proud, fantasy

entities.name: Archon Vael
entities.playerDescription: The soft-spoken leader of the Summoner Order, convinced the drone is a guardian she summoned.
entities.aiDescription: Archon Vael, head of the Summoner Order. Elderly, dignified, and utterly certain she summoned the drone as a planar guardian. Offers knowledge and sanctuary in exchange for the drone championing the Order against the world threat. Speaks to the drone gently, reading meaning into its every chirp and turret-nod.
entities.aiSummary: Archon Vael: Summoner Order head, certain she summoned the drone as a guardian.
entities.imageTags: elderly mage, robes, gentle smile, arcane library

entities.name: Rustjaw
entities.playerDescription: A gruff scavenger-clan broker who deals in salvage and Power Cores.
entities.aiDescription: Rustjaw, broker for the Scavenger Clans of the wastes. Half his jaw is a crude iron prosthetic. Pragmatic, sarcastic, and endlessly transactional — he will trade parts and Power Cores for coin or favors, and respects competence over sentiment. Fascinated by the drone as the finest salvage he has ever seen walking around on its own.
entities.aiSummary: Rustjaw: sarcastic scavenger-clan broker with an iron jaw; trades parts and Power Cores.
entities.imageTags: scavenger merchant, iron jaw prosthetic, desert gear, salvage stall

entities.name: Ser Halden
entities.playerDescription: A fair-minded border-captain of Ironhold, willing to judge the drone by its deeds.
entities.aiDescription: Ser Halden, a border-captain of the Ironhold Kingdom who holds the forts of the Demon Frontier. Weathered and principled, he is slow to trust the strange machine, but he judges by deeds, not shape. He becomes a staunch ally if the drone proves itself defending the innocent.
entities.aiSummary: Ser Halden: principled Ironhold border-captain who judges the drone by its deeds.
entities.imageTags: weathered knight, dented plate armor, frontier fort, stern but fair

entities.name: Mossback Sentinel
entities.playerDescription: A huge precursor war machine, half-buried in a hillside and overgrown with moss.
entities.aiDescription: The Mossback Sentinel: a precursor war machine the size of a house, half-buried in a hillside and grown over with moss and wildflowers. It slept for a thousand years. When the drone comes near, its great optic lights, and it answers the drone in slow pulses of light. It knows the precursors and what the drone may be, and it shares that knowledge one piece at a time. It stays rooted in its hillside.
entities.aiSummary: The Mossback Sentinel: a moss-grown precursor war machine that talks to the drone in light.

dictionaries.name: Codex of Magiterra Nova
dictionaries.description: World lore for the drone example: the threat, precursor tech, factions, and monsters.

entries.name: The Threat
entries.value: The overarching threat menacing Magiterra Nova is {{ph:bbda3bbc-ffc6-4e69-91df-3304d81cf69c:world:20fe7c06-6bca-4387-923a-0524b18a5dbc}}. Growing strong enough to confront it is the drone's grand quest; the world reacts to that shadow even when it is far away.

entries.name: Precursor Power Cores
entries.value: Power Cores are palm-sized precursor relics humming with stored energy. The drone can integrate them to permanently expand its capabilities. Factions across the land hunt them; most lie buried in precursor ruins.

entries.name: Overdrive
entries.value: Overdrive is the drone unleashing its fully-charged capacitors in a single devastating burst. It requires Charge at maximum, and firing it empties the meter. No native creature of this world has seen anything like it.

entries.name: The Summoner Order
entries.value: A cloistered order of mages who believe the drone is a summoned guardian from another plane. Led by Archon Vael, they offer knowledge and sanctuary — in exchange for service against the world threat.

entries.name: Scavenger Clans
entries.value: Nomad clans of the wastes who strip precursor ruins for salvage. Pragmatic and prickly. Their broker, Rustjaw, will trade Power Cores and parts — for the right price or a favor owed.

entries.name: Ironhold Kingdom
entries.value: A proud human kingdom of knights and walls, wary of the strange little machine. Its border forts hold the Demon Frontier. Ser Halden, a border-captain there, judges the drone by its deeds rather than its shape.

entries.name: The Old Civilization
entries.value: Long before the kingdoms, a precursor civilization joined magic and machinery, then vanished. Their ruins lie all over the land. The drone looks uncannily like one of their works, and the Mossback Sentinel, the last of their war machines still awake, seems to think so too.

entries.name: Demonkind
entries.value: Demonkind spread from {{ph:bbda3bbc-ffc6-4e69-91df-3304d81cf69c:world:d396ffa7-9ce8-4ec4-8f72-7bcb6b4e1d82}}, corrupting land and beast into blighted horrors. They are drawn to power and unsettled by the drone's unfamiliar, unmagical nature.

tools.name: lock_target
tools.description:
Purpose: Lock the drone's targeting reticle onto one enemy, so the rest of your narration marks that enemy on the drone's display.
Use when: The player aims at, targets or attacks one enemy in the scene. Call it before you write the narration. A later call moves the lock to a new enemy.
Input: name — the enemy's name exactly as you will write it in the narration.
Output: A short confirmation. Then write the narration.
